title: 45th Annual Victorian Tea
summary: A delicious taste of Christmas past, featuring a traditional catered tea and a festive tour of the Museum’s buildings.
description: A delicious taste of Christmas past, featuring a traditional catered tea and a festive tour of the Museum’s buildings. Two seating times are being offered at 11:30 AM and 1:30 PM. The cost is $32.00 plus HST per person. Book your time using the link below or contact the Museum at (905) 727-8954 or wsmuseum@townofws.ca to book your seating.
